anomalies.description: A man in a grey shirt is seen raising his right hand toward another man's head/face in a confined space, consistent with an imminent or ongoing physical strike; the second man is leaning back with head tilted upward, suggesting he is being attacked or bracing for impact.

Two men engage in a close-quarters physical fight in a confined space; one man (short hair, light shirt) attacks the other (dreadlocks, darker shirt), involving grabbing, striking, and grappling, with visible struggle and defensive reactions throughout.

Two men engage in a close-quarters physical fight in a dimly lit corridor; one man initiates with a grab and takedown, then transitions to a chokehold against the wall, while the other struggles and attempts to defend himself.
A man is lying prone on the floor, appearing subdued or incapacitated, while another person's arm and hand are positioned over him in a manner suggesting control or restraint.

Two men are engaged in close physical contact: one is holding the other’s head/neck area with a clenched fist near his face, while the second man is lying down and reacting with facial expressions indicating distress or resistance; this constitutes mutual physical combat or aggressive confrontation.
A man in a grey shirt is holding a knife to the throat of another man lying on a cot, who is visibly distressed and screaming; the attacker maintains control and pressure throughout the sequence.

A man in a grey shirt is gripping the neck/throat of another person who is lying down and appears helpless; the aggressor's expression is intense and his hand is tightly clenched, indicating a chokehold or strangulation attempt.

The aggressor maintains physical control over the victim, with his hand still on the victim’s neck/face area while the victim lies injured (blood visible on face), mouth open, and appears unable to resist—consistent with ongoing abuse of a helpless individual.

A man in a grey shirt is lying down, visibly injured (blood on face), while another man grips his neck/upper chest area and leans over him in an aggressive, controlling manner; the injured man appears restrained and unable to resist.; A man in a grey shirt is holding another man (with visible facial injuries and blood) by the neck/shoulder area in a controlling, non-consensual manner; the injured man appears restrained and unable to resist, consistent with abuse rather than mutual combat.

The interaction shifts: the previously restrained man (injured, grey shirt) appears to be actively resisting or engaging, while the other man (Paul Walker) grips his collar/neck with a clenched fist, suggesting escalation into mutual physical struggle. The ambiguity between abuse and fighting during this overlap justifies separate classification for the overlapping period.
